data_description.start_actions: Runs when this appliance's own activity source confirms activity. Any applicable detection thresholds or confirmation times are configured for that appliance.
data_description.finish_actions: Runs when this appliance's own activity source confirms activity has ended. Any applicable detection thresholds or confirmation times are configured for that appliance.
data_description.max_runtime_actions: Runs once when this appliance exceeds its configured maximum runtime. Without a maximum runtime, this hook does not run.
data_description.pending_actions: This appliance's reminder delay, interval, and additional-repeat limit control the schedule. The first run is not counted as a repeat. Three additional repeats allow up to four runs.
data_description.emptied_actions: Runs when this appliance's pending contents are cleared, such as by opening its door or using the clear control.
data_description.door_open_actions: This appliance's door-alarm delay, repeat interval, and additional-repeat limit control the schedule. The first run is not counted as a repeat.
data_description.compressor_inactive_actions: This appliance's compressor-alarm delay, repeat interval, and additional-repeat limit control the schedule. The first run is not counted as a repeat.
data_description.plug_off_actions: Runs immediately when this appliance's switch is switched off. Its own repeat interval and additional-repeat limit control later runs. The first run is not counted as a repeat.
data_description.lock_locked_actions: Runs when this opening's lock changes to locked.
data_description.lock_unlocked_actions: Runs when this opening's lock changes to unlocked.
data_description.shutter_open_actions: Runs when this associated shutter reaches the open state.
data_description.shutter_close_actions: Runs when this associated shutter reaches the closed state.
